name: Claude Dashboards
description: Turns questions about company data into a dashboard that stays current, connecting to data platforms (BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake) or CRMs such as Salesforce.
strengths: Each chart shows its query and last-refresh time
Connects to BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake and Salesforce
weaknesses: Off by default on Enterprise
Several integrations (Databricks Genie, Looker, Tableau, monday.com) listed as coming soon
notes: Source says 'beta on paid plans'; plans list expands that to Claude's paid tiers. Launch article names no model.

name: Claude Motion
description: Builds short animated explainers from a prompt as code that animates text, charts, shapes and images; edit in the editor or through Claude and download as MP4.
strengths: No video-generation model: no generated footage or AI-generated people
Editable in an editor or by asking Claude
weaknesses: Team and Enterprise only
Off by default on Enterprise until an owner enables it
notes: Launched alongside Claude Dashboards. On by default on Team plans. Launch article names no model.

name: Intelligent UI (ChatGPT)
description: ChatGPT combines text, visuals and interactive elements (comparisons, diagrams, calculators, bill splitters, games) to fit the question, and can start answering while still thinking or using tools.
strengths: Streams partial answers while still working
weaknesses: Not supported on the Pro reasoning option (GPT-6 Astra)
notes: Shipped with GPT-6 in the Chat tab: Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise use GPT-6 Sol, Free and Go use GPT-6 Luna (from the next day). openai.com blocks direct fetch; page text retrieved via a reader proxy.

name: Skills in Gemini
description: Reusable instruction sets in Gemini chat that run automatically on matching prompts and can be stacked; Gemini can build them from your chats.
weaknesses: 18+ only at launch
Will replace Gems
notes: Gems will be migrated to skills when Gems are removed. A Customize menu for skills and 40+ connected apps followed 2026-10-13.

name: Muse for Small Business
description: Business skills and connectors inside Muse that link Instagram professional analytics, Facebook Pages, Meta ad accounts and tools like Canva.
strengths: Connects Meta business accounts in a few clicks
weaknesses: US and Canada only
notes: Free for most use with subscription plans; plan names not given on the page.

name: ChatGPT Space and Pages
description: Space gathers Pages, files and related work in ChatGPT and can be shared; Pages are collaborative documents created from a conversation, a template or from scratch, with charts and interactive content.
strengths: Multiplayer editing and comments on Pages
Sharing a Page doesn't expose private chats or memory
weaknesses: Pro, Business and Enterprise only
Enterprise sharing is an opt-in preview
notes: Space replaces Library for accounts with access; Projects remain separate. Facts from the ChatGPT release notes (2026-09-29).

name: Dots
description: Always-on agents in ChatGPT with their own cloud computer and browser that take on ongoing responsibilities, keep working between conversations and message you when they need a decision.
strengths: Reach 4,000+ apps via plugins; reachable in ChatGPT, Slack and Teams, including voice calls
User-defined rules for acting alone vs asking
weaknesses: Pro access excludes the EEA, Switzerland and UK at launch
Enterprise is an off-by-default beta
Usage terms after the first month not yet published
notes: Blog: rolling out across Pro, Business Premium and Enterprise in eligible markets. Release notes: Pro and Business Premium users 18+; Enterprise beta off by default. Create a dot on desktop app or desktop web. openai.com blocks direct fetch; page text retrieved via a reader proxy.

name: Team Bots
description: Shared Grok Bots built around a team role with shared context, plugins, credentials and memories, usable individually or in Slack.
weaknesses: Public beta on Teams and Enterprise plans only

name: Ray-Ban Meta Audio
description: Meta's first audio-only AI glasses: 43 g frames with speakers and mics for music, calls and hands-free AI assistant use, connecting to Muse.
strengths: Up to 12 h battery plus 48 h from the case
weaknesses: No camera or display mentioned
notes: Pre-order from $349 at announcement, shipping October 13. Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 3) from $449 announced the same day. Muse on glasses is 'coming in the coming months', not launched.

name: Claude Docs and Claude Slides
description: Rich-text documents and slide decks created in any Claude conversation, editable by hand or by Claude, presentable from Claude and exportable to PowerPoint or PDF.
strengths: Works from any conversation with existing context, skills and connectors
weaknesses: Enterprise: off by default until an owner enables it
notes: Launched in beta on paid plans (Pro and Max first) on 2026-09-16 alongside the Cowork/chat merge; the 2026-10-08 Dashboards/Motion article says Docs, Slides and Design are out of beta and on every plan including Free. Availability/plans reflect that later state.

name: Muse
description: Meta's personal AI agent that completes tasks (email, travel, forms, shopping) on a dedicated cloud VM, works in the background and checks with you before sensitive actions; reachable in the Muse app and WhatsApp.
strengths: Separate Sentinel agent approves all internet traffic
Cannot see passwords or payment methods
weaknesses: US (later US and Canada) only
Encrypted Confidential VM not yet shipped
notes: iOS, Android and muse.ai. Free for most use with subscription plans; the fetched Meta page names no tiers (third-party reports of 'Power' $20 and 'Maximum' $100 were not verified). Connect 2026 (2026-09-24) added more shopping connectors and announced Muse on AI glasses and a Muse Charm device, neither launched yet. Muse Wonder models to power Muse soon (2026-10-12).

name: Grok Bot
description: Always-on AI teammates with their own cloud computer that sign into your tools, work across apps and inboxes, and come back only when they need approval.
strengths: Works on sites with no API or MCP
weaknesses: Beta
Enterprise on a waitlist at launch
notes: Desktop and iOS. Also available to Cursor Pro, Pro+, Ultra and Cursor Teams Standard/Premium subscribers. A later 'Grok Bot for Enterprise' post (listed on x.ai/news, date not captured) opened it to enterprises.

name: Build Mode
description: Grok builds working websites, apps, games and dashboards live in the chat and publishes them to a shareable link.
weaknesses: Early beta for SuperGrok Heavy only
notes: Web, iOS and Android.

name: Meta AI tasks, connectors and research deep dives
description: Meta AI gained email and calendar connections, daily briefings, slide generation, web research deep dives and ongoing tasks it follows through on without new prompts.
strengths: Research synthesis across papers and creator posts
weaknesses: Select markets only at launch
notes: Closest Meta equivalent to Deep Research ('research deep dives'); not a separately named mode. No plans stated. WhatsApp and more countries promised.

name: Grok for Microsoft Office
description: Free Microsoft 365 add-ins that bring Grok into Excel (formulas, scenarios, cited answers), with matching add-ins for Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.
notes: launchDate is the Excel add-in; xAI news also lists PowerPoint (2026-06-16), Word (2026-06-18) and Outlook (2026-07-21) add-ins and a Google Workspace add-on (2026-07-24).

name: Automations (Grok)
description: Grok runs jobs on a schedule or when a matching email arrives, opening a full conversation for each run and reporting back.
weaknesses: Email triggers need SuperGrok
notes: Scheduled automations available to everyone; email triggers included with SuperGrok.

name: Meta Model API
description: Meta's developer API for its Muse models, launched as a public preview with Muse Spark 1.1.
strengths: Serves Muse Spark, Muse Wonder and other Muse models
notes: Public preview 2026-07-09; GA announced in the Meta Connect 2026 developer recap (page undated; Connect news post 2026-09-24). Succeeds the Llama API preview.

name: ChatGPT Sites
description: Turns work or ideas into an interactive website or lightweight app (dashboards, trackers, prototypes, portals) inside ChatGPT, previewed privately and then published to a URL.
weaknesses: Not on Free or Go
Public publishing and expanded beta excluded from the EEA, Switzerland and UK at launch
notes: launchDate is the public-beta date; release notes say Business and Enterprise 'already have access' then, without an earlier date.

name: ChatGPT Work
description: An agent in ChatGPT for longer tasks that researches, works across connected apps and files, and produces finished documents, spreadsheets, presentations, reports and Sites, with Scheduled Tasks.
strengths: Approve important actions as it works
Desktop version can use local files and apps
weaknesses: Not on Free or Go
notes: Same day: App Directory replaced by the Plugin Directory, and a new desktop app combining Chat, Work and Codex. Enterprise/Edu had a two-week off-by-default preview. Later: GPT-6.1 Sol in Work (2026-09-29).

name: Voice Agent Builder
description: A no-code platform for configuring production voice agents on Grok Voice, with telephony, retrieval, tools, guardrails, MCP and observability.
weaknesses: Beta
notes: Benchmark claims (τ-voice Bench) on the page are xAI's own.

name: Claude Tag
description: Claude joins Slack channels as a team member: people tag it to delegate tasks and it replies in thread, working under its own identity. Replaces the earlier Claude in Slack app.
strengths: Builds context from the channels it is in
weaknesses: Team and Enterprise only
Slack only at launch
notes: Eligible orgs received a launch credit; admins could opt in to migrate from Claude in Slack within 30 days.

name: Daily Brief
description: A personalised daily overview built from connected apps (Gmail, Calendar) and Gemini chats, with 'Top of Mind' priorities and a 'Look Ahead' section.
weaknesses: US only, subscribers 18+
notes: Source says 'all Google AI subscribers 18 and over in the United States'; plans list expands that to Google's AI subscription tiers.

name: Gemini Spark
description: A 24/7 personal AI agent in the Gemini app that works on tasks on your behalf; the macOS version can organise folders and use local files.
strengths: macOS app can use local files (2026-06-30)
weaknesses: Google AI Ultra subscribers 18+ only
US only at launch
notes: Trusted testers at launch, beta for US Ultra subscribers 'in the coming weeks'. macOS availability 2026-06-30 in supported countries.

name: Skills (Grok)
description: Persistent instructions Grok remembers across conversations, including built-in skills for Word, PowerPoint, Excel and PDF output.
notes: Live on Grok 4.3 on grok.com, iOS and Android.

name: Personal finances in ChatGPT
description: Connect financial accounts via Plaid to see spending, bills, subscriptions, net worth and investments in a dashboard and ask questions grounded in that data.
weaknesses: Cannot move money, pay bills, trade or give regulated advice
US Pro only at launch
notes: Expanded to Plus and Android (2026-06-26) and to Free and Go (2026-10-02); credit scores added 2026-09-21. Plans reflect the latest expansion.

name: Connectors (Grok)
description: Deep integrations that let Grok read and act in everyday apps such as email, calendars, slides, spreadsheets and SharePoint.
notes: Advanced document editing 'powered by Grok 4.3'.

name: Claude Design
description: An Anthropic Labs product for making designs, prototypes, slides and one-pagers with Claude through conversation, inline comments, direct edits and adjustment controls, with hand-off to Claude Code.
strengths: Export to other tools, starting with Canva
Refine via comments, direct edits and generated sliders
weaknesses: Counts against subscription limits
Off by default on Enterprise at launch
notes: Launched as a research preview for Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise, powered by Claude Opus 4.7 (no models.json id, so modelIds is empty). From 2026-09-16 it also works inside conversations; the 2026-10-08 article says Design is out of beta and on every plan including Free, which availability/plans reflect.

name: Gemini desktop app
description: Native Gemini apps for Mac (Option+Space) and later Windows (Alt+Space) that summon Gemini alongside any app and can share your window for context.
strengths: Antigravity coding agent built into the macOS app (2026-10-13)
weaknesses: macOS 15+ required
notes: Mac 2026-04-15; Windows 10+ 2026-09-10; voice dictation anywhere on macOS 2026-07-29.

name: Notebooks in Gemini
description: Project-style personal knowledge bases in Gemini that group chats and files with custom instructions and sync with NotebookLM.
weaknesses: Web only at launch; not for under-18, Workspace or Education accounts
notes: Google's equivalent of Projects. Free users, mobile and more European countries planned 'in the coming weeks'.

name: New Meta AI app (Instant and Thinking modes)
description: Redesigned Meta AI app and meta.ai on Muse Spark with Instant and Thinking modes, parallel subagents, multimodal perception, health answers and visual coding of sites and mini-games.
strengths: Build and share websites and mini-games from a prompt
weaknesses: US only at launch
notes: Later update on the same page: live AI camera in the app, Marketplace-aware shopping mode, and Muse Spark rolling out to Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses in the US and Canada.

name: Dispatch and computer use in Cowork
description: Lets Claude use your computer (browser, mouse, keyboard, screen) in Claude Cowork and Claude Code when no connector exists, with Dispatch for assigning tasks from your phone while it keeps working on the desktop.
strengths: Uses connectors first, screen control only as fallback
Asks permission before acting or opening new apps
weaknesses: Research preview that 'won't always work perfectly'
Desktop app must be running and awake
notes: Release notes list a persistent phone-to-Cowork thread (Dispatch) as a research preview on 2026-03-17 (Max first, then Pro) and computer use in Cowork/Claude Code on 2026-03-23.

name: Personal Intelligence
description: Connect Gemini to Gmail, Photos, YouTube and Search for more proactive, personalised answers.
strengths: Off by default; choose which apps to connect
weaknesses: US only beta
Not for Workspace business or education plans
notes: Later brought to AI Mode in Search and powers Daily Brief.

name: Claude Cowork
description: An agentic mode for non-coding knowledge work: describe a goal and Claude works in the folders and tools you choose to complete multi-step tasks.
strengths: Merged into every Claude conversation from 2026-09-16
weaknesses: Uses limits faster than chat (per pricing page)
notes: Release notes: research preview for Max on macOS 2026-01-12; Pro 2026-01-16; generally available on macOS and Windows 2026-04-09; web and mobile from 2026-07-07; merged with chat ('one Claude') 2026-09-16. The original launch post URL now serves a product page without a date, so the launch date comes from the release notes.

name: ChatGPT Health
description: A dedicated space in ChatGPT for health conversations that can connect medical records, Apple Health and wellness apps, kept separate from other chats and not used for training.
strengths: Health chats, memory and files kept separate
Connect medical records and wellness apps
weaknesses: Waitlist and small early group at launch
Excludes EEA, Switzerland and UK; medical records US only
notes: Web and iOS at launch, Android coming. openai.com blocks direct fetch; page text retrieved via a reader proxy.

name: Grok Business and Grok Enterprise
description: Team and enterprise tiers of Grok with no training on customer data, shared workspaces, Google Drive apps and Collections-backed Projects; Enterprise adds SSO, SCIM and an Enterprise Vault.
strengths: Permission-aware Google Drive search with citations
notes: Business is self-serve; Enterprise and Enterprise Vault via sales.

name: Collections API
description: A hosted RAG system in the xAI API: upload PDFs, spreadsheets or codebases and search them semantically, by keyword or hybrid.
notes: Indexing and storage free for the first week at launch.

name: Grok Voice Agent API
description: An API for building multilingual voice agents that call tools and search real-time data, on the stack behind Grok Voice in the apps and Tesla vehicles.
notes: Ranking claims (Big Bench Audio #1) are xAI's own, citing Artificial Analysis.

name: Claude for Excel
description: Claude working inside Microsoft Excel, launched in beta alongside Claude Opus 4.5 and later extended to PowerPoint (2026-02-05) and cross-app work across Excel and PowerPoint (2026-03-11).
strengths: Extended to PowerPoint and cross-app Office work
weaknesses: Beta at launch
Max, Team and Enterprise only at launch
notes: Facts from the Claude release notes only; launch blog post not fetched.

name: Agent Tools API
description: Server-side tools in the xAI API giving agents real-time X data, web search, remote code execution and more.
notes: Launched with Grok 4.1 Fast, which has no models.json id.

name: Gemini Agent
description: An experimental tool that completes multi-step tasks using Gmail, Calendar, Deep Research, Canvas and live web browsing.
strengths: Confirms before critical actions like sending email or purchases
weaknesses: Experimental
Ultra subscribers 18+ in the US only
notes: Launched with Gemini 3; release notes say 'Gemini 3' without naming Pro, so modelIds left empty.

name: Visual layout and dynamic view
description: Gemini Labs features that answer with immersive visual layouts or with a custom interactive interface that Gemini designs and codes for the prompt.
weaknesses: Experimental Labs feature rolled out to subsets of users
notes: Richer interactive responses (multi-layer images, video overviews) followed in the main chat 2026-05-19.

name: Group chats in ChatGPT
description: Shared conversations where several people and ChatGPT plan, decide and collaborate in one thread.
strengths: Search, images, file upload and dictation enabled
weaknesses: Pilot in NZ, Japan, South Korea and Taiwan at launch
Creation of new group chats ended 2026-07-09
notes: Retirement began 2026-07-09: no new group chats, but existing ones remain usable 'for now' and later become read-only, so retiredDate is left null.

name: ChatGPT Atlas
description: A web browser built around ChatGPT, with browser memories and an agent mode that can work in tabs on your behalf.
weaknesses: macOS only at launch
Retired 2026-08-09
notes: Launched worldwide on macOS for Free, Plus, Pro and Go; beta for Business; Enterprise/Edu if admin-enabled. Agent mode in preview for Plus, Pro and Business. Deprecated 2026-07-09; scheduled to stop working 2026-08-09.

name: Agent Skills
description: Folders of instructions, scripts and resources that Claude loads only when relevant, usable in the Claude apps, the Claude Developer Platform (API) and Claude Code.
strengths: Same skills work across apps, API and Claude Code
Published as an open standard (2025-12-18 update)
weaknesses: Requires the Code Execution Tool beta
Team/Enterprise admins must enable org-wide

name: AgentKit
description: A developer toolset for building, deploying and optimising agents: visual Agent Builder, ChatKit for embedding chat UIs, Connector Registry and expanded Evals.

weaknesses: Agent Builder in beta at launch
Agent Builder and Evals being wound down from 2026-11-30

name: Apps in ChatGPT and the Apps SDK
description: Interactive third-party apps that run inside ChatGPT conversations, plus the Apps SDK (built on MCP) for developers to build them.

Launch partners included Booking.com, Canva, Figma, Spotify, Zillow
weaknesses: Excluded the EEA, Switzerland and UK at launch
notes: Business, Enterprise and Edu got apps in preview 2025-11-13. App directory opened 2025-12-18; replaced by the Plugin Directory 2026-07-09.

Product discontinued

name: Vibes
description: A feed of short AI-generated videos in the Meta AI app and meta.ai where people create, remix and share clips, including cross-posting to Instagram and Facebook.
strengths: Remix any video in the feed
Cross-post to Instagram and Facebook Stories and Reels
weaknesses: Early preview at launch
notes: Expanded to Europe in November 2025.

name: ChatGPT Pulse
description: ChatGPT did asynchronous research overnight based on chats, memory, feedback and connected apps and delivered a daily set of visual update cards.

Sunset in favour of scheduled tasks

US limited retail at launch

Responses take minutes

Slide generation in beta at launch

10-second clips

Ultra got early Veo 3 with native audio

Pro tier capped at 100 generations/month
